description:
Welcome to FIRE Rich Rice — real estate investor, freedom junkie, and founder of the FIRE Center.

Over the past several years, I’ve flipped, held, and creatively financed deals across Southern California — while building the FIRE Center — a thriving community where investors come together every week to network, learn, and close real deals.

On this channel, you’ll find:
🔥 Real deal breakdowns from my portfolio and my students
🔥 Creative financing strategies that actually work in today’s market
🔥 Behind-the-scenes from weekly FIRE Center meetings & classes
🔥 Tools like FIRE Genie, my custom deal-analyzing AI chatbot
🔥 Hard-earned lessons from years in the trenches

This isn’t guru hype — it’s what real investors are doing right now to build wealth, cashflow, and freedom.

👉 For all the tools, classes, and community you need to escape the rat race faster →FIREcenterHQ.com
